---
slug: an_awakening
title: An Awakening
blurb: Matieu, one of the Righteous Few descended from Kluex, watches helplessly as Kluex takes the wheel of his body, and starts plotting to turn that power to his own ends.
authors: Maxwell
season: FF2
format: prose
---

Matieu never had to worry about it. He always had seed on him, his parents always provided for him. They would rather go without seed than him. He never had to deal with the side effects. But try as he might, his entire family knew it would happen eventually. Matieu was told from a young age he was of the Righteous Few, a direct connection in bloodline to the one that is now known as Kluex. These few, however, are hated by the population, so many sate this vassalship with a special kind of birdseed, although regular seed would suffice. But the day it happened, it was strange. Almost as if he was watching the broadcast of a life he knew was his, but not. Kluex was taking the wheel, and he could only watch. For now.

Matieu trained his mind, finding a key to the lock. Eventually, he developed the perfect key, the warden key, per se, that could open any lock Kluex put on his mind. Kluex couldn’t tell, but he was studying what Kluex said, did, and thought. He could control this affliction and use it for himself, a selfish move, but one that could save many people. He just had to wait until the time was right, and then he could use the divine power of Kluex to benefit people. He’d be a hero! His family would be so proud of him! But he wouldn’t know how Kluex would sit with this little overthrow...
